title: Between Tides
subtitle: I write to breathe. I write to understand. I write to make space. I write to make sens. Writen slowly. Read gently.

posts.title: Apparently I'm the Problem.
posts.description: Working in adult social care can be incredibly difficult, especially when mental health is involved. Sometimes it's even more challenging when you're supporting older people who have spent decades believing the world owes them something.
